comment.body: Thanks for the report and bug-report ZIP. Could you describe the exact steps you take after selecting an image, including whether you launch Image Resizer from the Explorer context menu, which size/settings you select, and what happens after you click Resize? Please include any visible error and a sample image type/extension. Also confirm whether Image Resizer is enabled in PowerToys Settings and whether the context-menu entry appears.

actions.note: Draft only; no upstream comment is posted without explicit approval.
